name: Posty: Social Media Scheduler
description: Write, schedule and publish posts to 20 social platforms (Facebook, Instagram, X, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, Threads, Bluesky, Pinterest, Mastodon, Tumblr, WordPress, Telegram, Discord, Slack and more) with a content calendar and full-quality photo and video uploads. Hosted MCP with OAuth browser sign-in; a Posty account is required (free trial at posty.hu).
author: Posty
